RAT.Settings.markerStyle.Name: Marker style
RAT.Settings.markerStyle.Hint: Ghost, boot prints, position pin or a custom image for all players. Movement rotation is optional for every style. Hidden movement never changes the marker.
RAT.Settings.rememberHidden.Name: When the GM hides a token
RAT.Settings.rememberHidden.Hint: The GM Hidden button: remove the known marker or keep it until rediscovery or expiry. Separate from invisibility, darkness and ordinary loss of sight. Unseen tokens are never revealed.
RAT.Settings.opacity.Name: Opacity (%)
RAT.Settings.opacity.Hint: 30-80%; default 50%. Applies to every marker style.
RAT.Settings.labels.Name: Caption style
RAT.Settings.labels.Hint: Personal style: standard or high contrast. Available while the GM allows captions.
RAT.Unsupported: Probably Just a Rat: observation was suspended because the required Foundry VTT 14 canvas API is unavailable.
RAT.Token.Label: Remember token position
RAT.Token.Hint: Hostile tokens are remembered by default. Overrides still require visual detection and never reveal unseen tokens.
RAT.Clear.Name: Forget all positions
RAT.Clear.Hint: Clear only this client's memory. No key is assigned by default.
RAT.OpacityMigrationFailed: Could not update the opacity setting format. Set a value from 30 to 80% manually.
RAT.CacheUnavailable: Could not save local position memory. Markers still work, but may disappear after reloading.
RAT.Settings.sharePings.Name: Ping audience
RAT.Settings.sharePings.Hint: Show saved-position pings to the sender or everyone. Supports Shift/Alt.
RAT.PingFailed: Could not display the remembered-position ping.
RAT.Settings.showNames.Name: Show target name
RAT.Settings.showNames.Hint: The previously observed token name. Unavailable and Secret names stay unknown.
RAT.CaptionMigrationFailed: Could not update the personal caption style. Select standard or high contrast manually.
RAT.Settings.grayscale.Name: Desaturation (%)
RAT.Settings.grayscale.Hint: Default 30%. 0% preserves the marker's original colors; 100% makes its artwork fully grayscale. Applies to all styles; the outline keeps its selected color.
RAT.Settings.showRounds.Name: Show rounds since loss of sight
RAT.Settings.showRounds.Hint: Number of combat rounds elapsed since the target was last visible.
RAT.Settings.outline.Name: Outline
RAT.Settings.outline.Hint: Add a contrasting outline to the marker artwork. Applies to all styles. Off by default.
RAT.Settings.outlineColor.Name: Outline color
RAT.Settings.outlineColor.Hint: Outline color for every marker style, independent of grayscale.
RAT.Controls.Title: Position memory
RAT.Controls.ActionFailed: Could not perform the position-memory action.
RAT.Settings.memoryRounds.Name: Combat lifetime (rounds)
RAT.Settings.memoryRounds.Hint: Rounds after loss of sight before a marker expires. Positive whole number; default 2. Applies to existing positions.
RAT.Settings.memoryMinutes.Name: Out-of-combat lifetime (minutes)
RAT.Settings.memoryMinutes.Hint: Real minutes after loss of sight before a marker expires. Positive number; default 1. Applies to existing positions.
RAT.Settings.combatOnly.Name: When to remember positions
RAT.Settings.combatOnly.Hint: Combat only: remember during a started scene or global combat; memory is cleared outside combat. In and out of combat: use the corresponding lifetimes.
RAT.Scene.OverlandMemory.Name: Memory mode
RAT.Scene.OverlandMemory.Hint: Override world rules for this scene. Requires token vision. Long memory is stored locally and restored when returning to the original scene and vision source.
RAT.Settings.customMarkerImage.Name: Image file
RAT.Settings.customMarkerImage.Hint: Choose a file through Foundry. Transparent PNG/WebP works well; aspect ratio is preserved. Unavailable images fall back to the position pin.
RAT.CustomImageFailed: Could not load the custom marker image. A position pin is shown instead.
RAT.Scene.OverlandMemory.Title: Overland map
RAT.Settings.customMarkerRotate.Name: Rotate with movement
RAT.Settings.customMarkerRotate.Hint: Rotate all marker styles along the token's last continuously observed movement. The angle freezes after loss of sight. Off by default; ghosts keep the token's observed artwork angle.
RAT.Settings.memoryRounds.Validation: Enter a whole number of rounds greater than zero.
RAT.Settings.memoryMinutes.Validation: Enter a finite number of minutes greater than zero.
RAT.Scene.Effective.long: No lifetimes; keeps markers on Hidden; works outside combat; no clearing between combats. Restored on return to the original scene and vision source. Removed on rediscovery or manually; local storage is bounded to 12 contexts and 2 MB.
RAT.Scene.Effective.disabled: Positions are not remembered and markers are not shown on this scene.
RAT.Scene.Effective.world: Effective: {activity}. Combat lifetime: {rounds} rounds; outside combat: {minutes} min. On Hidden: {hidden}. Memory clears between combats.
RAT.Scene.Effective.CombatOnly: combat only; memory clears outside combat
RAT.Settings.Preview.Title: Preview
RAT.Settings.Preview.Hint: Works without saved positions. Save settings to keep your changes.
RAT.Settings.Menu.Label: Settings sections
RAT.Settings.language.Name: Module language
RAT.Settings.language.Hint: Personal setting: follow Foundry or choose a language for Probably Just a Rat. Applies after saving.
RAT.LanguageFailed: Could not load the selected module language. Using the Foundry language for now.
RAT.Settings.SceneMemory.Hint: Current scene: {scene}. Opens the Visibility tab with this scene’s memory rules.
RAT.Settings.SceneMemory.Unavailable: No current scene is available. Open a scene to change its memory rules.
RAT.Settings.SceneMemory.Failed: Could not open the current scene settings.
RAT.Settings.captionStyle.Name: Caption style
RAT.Settings.captionStyle.Hint: Off disables captions for everyone and hides the player setting. Standard or high contrast sets the initial style; players may switch between these two styles.
RAT.Settings.Preview.Illustrative: Schematic example: the actual ghost, boot prints and position pin look different on the scene.
